baselineFinding.readAloud: Current error is calm and understandable. The main defect is delivery/location. No cause-specific photo diagnosis can be inferred from its generic catch.

Later implementation must ensure every genuine non-cancellation recovery failure has a visible state or explicit return/rechoose path; do not silently equate dismissal/cancellation with failure.

recommendedRepair.choice: One persistent native Form error in the final recovery action section, immediately before Recover selected data; remove displaced top-only duplicate.

content.heading: Recovery couldn't finish
content.body: Your current files haven't been replaced. Check the file and try again.
content.confirmation: Keep Replace selected data? with Recover / Not now.

recommendedRepair.presentation: Semantic primary text for the essential heading/body, native wrapping and spacing, full Dynamic Type, no fixed height/line limit/shrink-to-fit. Keep owned teal on actions. No color-only error indication, new decorative panel, toast or modal required.
recommendedRepair.delivery: On each new genuine failure, after the error row exists, automatically reveal its beginning from the action position once. Account for navigation glass and bottom safe area. At largest type, failure heading/state must be immediately visible without a manual search and the full body/actions reachable by ordinary scrolling. Do not repeatedly snap scrolling while the person reads.
recommendedRepair.accessibility: Expose one coherent error heading/body with stable identity; move VoiceOver focus to the error after insertion or deliver an equivalent single complete announcement with the error as the next logical reading target. Verify real spoken result; avoid focus plus announcement causing duplicates. Keep retry/Back/review controls reachable. Reduce Motion uses a nonanimated reveal. Accessibility assertions alone are not visual proof.
recommendedRepair.state: Keep selected domains and explicit omission choice on failure/Not now; never turn omission on, retry, replace data or dismiss automatically. New retry clears stale failure and shows real busy/Cancel; fresh failure is revealed again; success replaces failure with actual completion, with no stale or contradictory message.
recommendedRepair.truthfulness: Retain the no-replacement sentence only for verified precommit failures. If an error can occur after a commit, use a phase-correct outcome instead of this guarantee. Do not infer photo-specific cause or offer omission as an automatic fix without typed/proven cause. Preserve private-copy/old-photo and Apple Health/pending-work consequences.

alternatives.option: Only darken or recolor the existing top error
alternatives.judgment: Insufficient: improves a revealed label but does not bring it to the person at the action.

alternatives.option: Keep top location and automatically scroll/focus it
alternatives.judgment: Viable smaller code change if proven; less preferred because it separates error from retry and transports the person across unrelated domains. Must still preserve choices and prove immediate reveal.

alternatives.option: Native failure alert plus persistent Form error
alternatives.judgment: Acceptable fallback if Form reveal/focus cannot be made reliable. More interruptive, needs dismissal, and previously observed gray alert body must not carry essential facts alone. Never auto-retry on dismissal.

alternatives.option: Toast, brief banner, haptic or announcement alone
alternatives.judgment: Insufficient alone: transient or sensory-only feedback loses persistent error context; no arbitrary timeout.

Capture actual primary and compact phones in normal, dark and largest type. For each, begin at the bottom Recover action, confirm, trigger a real failure, and record the first resulting viewport before ANY test-driven swipe, scroll-to-label, or error-search helper.

Assert busy ends and no success is shown on failure; immediately visible error heading/state is within actual viewport after native presentation settles. At ordinary type inspect whole message/retry together where feasible; at largest inspect whole strings through genuine overlapping scrolls without shrinking type or claiming unseen frame padding.

Inspect all supplied originals individually at original detail with exact source/build/test/export metadata and byte/hash/length binding; full native JSON is supplemental. Retain the original Source176 failed wait and current scrolled-test boundaries.

Exercise repeated failure from bottom and another current scroll position, retry, Not now, Back/reopen, and deliberate omission on/off. No automatic omission, selection loss, confirmation bypass, duplicate worker, stale error after success, or failure alert on cancellation.

Verify VoiceOver focus/spoken error and subsequent retry/navigation order directly; verify Reduce Motion. If unavailable, retain an explicit open accessibility gate; do not claim it from identifiers or stills.

Recheck all four missing/damaged legacy/encrypted safety boundaries: precommit current/prior bytes+metadata and source identity exact, no stage/receipt/checkpoint publication on failure/Not now; explicit omission retry only, complete intended records, correct omitted-photo count, cleanup/relaunch and preserved healthy data.
